summary: Agent変更を一目的の小さなbatchに制限し、機械precheck（lint/型/構造rule）を先行させ、人間のarchitecture reviewをlayer境界・data・migration等の高impact箇所へ集中する。

evidence.summary: small-batches / machine-prechecks / risk-based review はoperationally-supported（GitHub 2026-05-07運用知見、DORA small batch仮説）。比較効果は未確立。
GitHub: Agent PRの小分割、機械検査先行、risk-based review、作者確認。vendor実務知見。
fresh contextのreviewer subagentで『consistency with our existing middleware patterns』等を確認するWriter/Reviewer pattern。

git-workflow-and-versioning (public, reputation established): read skills/git-workflow-and-versioning/SKILL.md from a fresh clone of addyosmani/agent-skills@main: 'Don't combine formatting changes with behavior changes. Don't combine refactors with features. Each type of change should be a separate commit - and ideally a separate PR', followed by the review-cost ladder 'Target ~100 lines per commit/PR ... ~300 acceptable for a single logical change ... ~1000 lines split into smaller changes' and a pointer to code-review-and-quality for splitting strategies.

applies_when: 分割しても整合性を保てる変更
not_applicable_when: atomicな大規模移行（分割自体がrisk）

expected_effect.primary: architecture reviewの認知負荷を下げ、構造欠陥の流出を減らす

risks: 形式的分割で依存を壊す
cost: PR size policyとreview checklist整備に数時間
known_failure_modes: AI reviewを人間判断の完全代替にする

existing_asset.confirmed_by: read skills/git-workflow-and-versioning/SKILL.md from a fresh clone of addyosmani/agent-skills@main: 'Don't combine formatting changes with behavior changes. Don't combine refactors with features. Each type of change should be a separate commit - and ideally a separate PR', followed by the review-cost ladder 'Target ~100 lines per commit/PR ... ~300 acceptable for a single logical change ... ~1000 lines split into smaller changes' and a pointer to code-review-and-quality for splitting strategies.
matched_on: one purpose per commit/PR - never mix refactor, fix and feature in one review
explicit size thresholds that trigger a split
atomic small changes framed as what keeps agent-speed output reviewable and revertible

evidence: https://skills.sh/addyosmani/agent-skills/git-workflow-and-versioning (20.5K installs; Trust Hub Pass, Socket Pass, Snyk Pass)

existing_asset.verified_by: existing-skill research 2026-08-15 (ai-development-improvement 0.7.1 lookup + reputation pass, Opus workers)

alternates.why_not_primary: Pass-1 primary with the same rule and split triggers, plus the review-depth argument, but the repo has 0 stars and no commits since March.

Established, and it supplies the machine-precheck destination ('automate quality gates so that no change reaches production without passing tests, lint, type checking, and build', shift-left framing), but it does not order those gates before human review or triage review by risk.

evidence: https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills (87,489 stars, last commit 2026-08-14; skills/ci-cd-and-automation read from a fresh clone)

alternates.why_not_primary: Reviews a diff on Standards and Spec axes in parallel sub-agents and explicitly skips what tooling already enforces, but it does not limit batch size and treats every hunk at the same depth.
